data_classification: synthetic-only; no market payloads, accounts, credentials, or broker activity

oracle.engine: QuantLib FdBlackScholesVanillaEngine; Douglas default scheme; two damping steps
oracle.original_fixture_usage: Only synthetic model inputs are read; the stored base price is checked after re-pricing, and the original Delta, Gamma, and Theta columns are ignored.

probe_definition.base_price: Recomputed by QuantLib at the same input spot and maturity; checked against the original finest-grid row within 1e-10
probe_definition.continuous_yield: flat continuously compounded yield; fixed cash-dividend cases excluded
probe_definition.price_units: per one underlying unit; no contract multiplier or currency conversion
probe_definition.spot_bump_unit: underlying units; positive and negative price are at S+h and S-h
probe_definition.time_bump_unit: nearest integer millisecond via llround(T_ms*f); positive and negative price are at T+h and T-h
probe_definition.finite_difference_convention: central first and second spot differences; central negative time difference for Theta; Theta unit is ACT/365F years per underlying unit

limits: The probe compares finite-difference conventions over a finite synthetic matrix and establishes no general price, Greek, IV, or runtime error budget.
It does not validate a production American solver, exercise behavior on real contracts, discrete dividends, settlement, or market prices.
The production positive-time American result remains AmericanPricingAccuracyUnverified.
